title: Common flat proper refinement of an already chosen complex
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I → CommRing a diagram of Noetherian rings, and c a limiting cone of the spectra with affine point S. Fix i ≤ j, a finitely presented morphism f:X_i → Spec(R_i) [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], and a bounded cochain complex H of finitely presented modules on X_j = X_i ×_{Spec(R_i)} Spec(R_j). Assume the pullbacks of its terms to X = X_i ×_{Spec(R_i)} S [def-pc-base-change] are flat over S and have support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Then there is k ≥ j and a bounded finitely presented complex K on X_k, with terms flat over Spec(R_k) and support proper over Spec(R_k), whose limit pullback is termwise isomorphic to the limit pullback of this given H, with every isomorphism commuting with every differential. This assertion starts from a chosen model H; it does not descend a complex from X.

proof.text: Choose a finite interval of degrees outside which H is zero. For each degree inside it, view H^n on the finitely presented scheme X_j. Pullback pasting identifies its pullback to the limit with the displayed moduleBaseChange. Apply eventual flatness (05LY) and proper-support descent (081G) to this fixed term. For a preorder first restrict along a final directed poset in its thin filtered category; finality preserves the limit, so the same argument applies and its output transports back.

For each of the finitely many degrees choose a common stage above its flatness and proper-support stages, then choose one upper bound of all these stages and j. Further cartesian pullback preserves flatness, finite presentation and proper support. Zero terms outside the interval have flat sections and empty proper support. If the interval is empty take j.

Apply the additive tensor-pullback functor termwise to H at the common stage; it preserves zero objects, so the result is bounded. The tensor-pullback composition isomorphism and pullback pasting identify the limit pullback of this complex with that of H. Naturality with respect to H.d n m gives the displayed differential equation.

theorem exists_chosen_complex_flat_proper_refinement
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ k : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj k)]
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (H : CochainComplex (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules ℤ)
    (hH_bounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (H.X n))
    (hH_fp : ∀ n : ℤ, (H.X n).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hH_flat : ∀ n : ℤ,
      ((Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj (H.X n)).IsFlatOver
        (pullback.snd f (c.π.app (op i))))
    (hH_support : ∀ n : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver
      (pullback.snd f (c.π.app (op i)))
      ((Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj (H.X n))) :
    ∃ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k)
      (K : CochainComplex
        (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).Modules ℤ),
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (K.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (K.X n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (K.X n).IsFlatOver
        (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver
        (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))) (K.X n)) ∧
      ∃ e : ∀ n : ℤ,
          (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))).obj
            (K.X n) ≅
          (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj (H.X n),
        ∀ n m : ℤ,
          (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))).map
            (K.d n m) ≫ (e m).hom =
          (e n).hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).map (H.d n m)
